The Gallica/archive disagreement is recorded so it is not re-opened from either image alone. LXV' with Rom 10:21 wording at 0230B; 'Nonne hic ipse Dominus Deus tuus ... et acquisivit te?' at 0230D; 'Peccatis vestris venundati estis ...' at 0230D.
